title: Recruiting coordinator daily scratchpad - 2026-03-17
content:
Quick notes / running todo list - Tue 2026-03-17
Owner: Avery Patel (recruiting coordinator)
Context: people-ops support for hiring across Eng (serving-runtime), Applied ML, and Product. Working doc - messy.

MORNING PRIORITIES (first 90 mins)
- Confirm panel availability for Priya Sharma (SWE backend) - onsite loop (onsite planned 3/24). Need final panel order + lunch logistics. ACTION: DM @Jordan in #recruiting to lock panels by 11:00 PST.
- Send follow-up to Maya Thompson after take-home submission - ask for short notes about tradeoffs. ACTION: email template below.
- Reschedule Diego Alvarez phone screen (candidate requested 2pm -> prefers 4pm). Check interviewer availability: Liam O'Connor: OK at 4:15-5:15. Confirm and update calendar.

CALL/INTERVIEW SCHEDULE (today)
- 09:30 PST - Quick sync w/ Riley (30m) - prep for week ramp; agenda: interview coverage, panel rosters.
- 11:00 PST - Panel confirmation batch (outgoing emails to panelists).
- 14:00 PST - Diego Alvarez - initial phone screen (tentative, may move to 16:00)
- 15:30 PST - Recruiter standup (weekly)

CANDIDATE FOLLOW-UPS (must send today)
- Maya Thompson - take-home submitted 03/16. Ask for 2-3 sentence summary of approach + any open questions. Template: 
  Hi Maya - thanks again for the submission. Quick ask: could you share a 2-3 sentence summary of your approach and any tradeoffs you considered? That helps the panel focus feedback. No rush - if possible today.
  TODO: send at 09:45 after coffee.

- Priya Sharma - interview loop planned 03/24. Outstanding: confirm panel, dietary restrictions, travel stipend details. ACTION: create travel stipend email draft; copy hiring manager (Siddharth).

- Diego Alvarez - candidate asked to move to 4pm. If moved, need to update note taker (assign to Jordan). Also request phone number to confirm. ACTION: text template ready.

- Liam O'Connor (interviewer) - confirm availability for overflow interviews on 3/23 afternoon. Might be asked. ACTION: ping in Slack tonight if no reply from calendar.

RECRUITER/TEAM TASKS
- Update interview packet for SWE backend (small change to take-home scoring rubric: add scaling question). Draft done - need Jordan to review.
- Add new routing matrix doc link to panelists' invite: https://confluence.company/recruiting/routing-matrix - small note in calendar description.

NOTES ON FEEDBACK PROCESS
- Remind panelists to submit feedback within 48hrs. Use Slack reminder and calendar follow-up. Template below for Slack thread.

MESSAGES / TEMPLATES (quick copy)
- Candidate follow-up (Maya): see above.
- Panel confirmation (email): 
  Subject: Interview panel confirmation - Priya Sharma (03/24)
  Body: Hi [Name],
  Thanks for agreeing to join the loop for Priya Sharma on 03/24. Your slot: [time]. Panel details and docs: https://confluence.company/recruiting/priya-schedule. Please complete feedback in Greenhouse within 48 hours. Let me know if you need any changes.

- Reschedule DM (Diego): "Hi Diego - we can move your screen to 4:15pm PST today. Does that work? If yes, I'll send an updated invite and a quick confirmation text."

ADMIN / OPS
- Background check link outstanding for Diego - set reminder for candidate to complete after interview (if moving forward).
- Expense code for travel stipend: TRVL-ENG-2026 (confirm with finance - cc: finance@company).

PENDING ITEMS / blockers
- Panelist confirmations outstanding: 2 of 6 for Priya (Sidd hiring manager follow-up needed).
- Take-home rubric update needs Jordan review - blocking final scoring matrix for next week.

END-OF-DAY CHECKLIST
- Send end-of-day status to hiring manager for each active loop (Priya, Maya, Diego).
- Confirm all calendar invites sent and have panel docs linked.
- Triage any candidate replies that came in after 4pm.

NOTES TO SELF / misc
- Remember to cc people-ops@company on any offer-related comms.
- Update recruiting board (JIRA-948) with today's confirmed panels and any reschedules.
- Quick wins: batch out panel confirmation emails between 11:00-12:00 to avoid context switches.

---
Drafted by Avery - will tidy and send templates.
